title: SRD: only the 14 listed creature types exist; engine: Study naming another type (goblinoid) crashes with a KeyError instead of a clean refusal

history.summary: actions.study now checks that a named creature_type is one of the 14 SRD types before looking up its skill. Any other name (such as 'goblinoid') now gets a clean Refusal citing page=179, rule=GLOSS.creature-type#3 and ruling R-39, and no action is spent or check rolled. Before, it raised a KeyError. The fix also makes T-92's test pass (a session `study` command naming 'dwarf' as a type), because it goes through the same function. Unit tests, the ticket's tests with --runxfail, ruff and dev-gate all pass.
